title: Send bus
description: Sends a part of up to four sounds to a shared effect: through is the plain sum, send the sum with a send level per input.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.doc: How much of each input goes to the shared effect, in decibels (-60 is nothing).

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
